worker_rule.before_proposing_new_foundational_abstra: search canonical orientation and cited source repositories; if an extension is still required, identify the exact canonical concepts searched and the specific insufficiency

concepts.name: existence_is_stronger_than_presence
concepts.canonical_statement: Presence alone does not establish coherent or admissible existence; individuation, coherence, transition capacity, viability, observability, reconstructability, authority, purpose, relational and compositional conditions are distinct.
concepts.authority_boundary: Existence/admissibility theory does not itself create component execution authority.
non_claims: presence does not imply coherence
physical viability does not prove legitimate authority
information integration does not prove consciousness
common_misinterpretations: treating detectable presence as sufficient existence standing
collapsing all AE dimensions into one scalar capability state

concepts.name: observability_and_reconstructability_are_distinct
concepts.canonical_statement: Observability concerns whether relevant state can be distinguished from evidence; reconstructability concerns whether prior state, policy, authority, evidence, decision and transition history can be recovered.
concepts.authority_boundary: Neither observability nor reconstructability is certification, correct interpretation, or execution authority.
non_claims: observable does not mean authorized
reconstructable does not mean executable
common_misinterpretations: treating a receipt as execution authority
treating an observation as proof of every causal or authority relation

concepts.name: relational_and_contextual_coherence_are_joint_state_properties
concepts.canonical_statement: Relational recoverability and compositional compatibility are defined in joint state space; isolated endpoint state cannot by itself establish contextual coherent standing.
concepts.authority_boundary: Joint-state coherence constrains admissibility but does not itself authorize execution.
non_claims: co-presence of two entities does not prove a governed relationship
existential projection does not establish coherence in the actual environment
common_misinterpretations: assuming two synchronized-looking states are continuous merely because both exist
ignoring neighboring entity state when evaluating relational coherence

concepts.name: transition_table_is_structural_and_non_authorizing
concepts.canonical_statement: TT owns transition-element identity, structural relationships, standing requirements, outcome regions, registry structure and bounded local allocation; its derivation and mapping layers are descriptive/testable and do not create execution authority.
concepts.authority_boundary: TT never inherits execution authority from geometry, ontology, semantics, governance, validation, proof-candidate registration, destination receipts or external framework alignment.
non_claims: TT does not grant product capability authority
TT does not authorize irreversible external commit
TT destination awareness is not publication or release
common_misinterpretations: describing TT as a capability issuer
treating a structural transition element as permission to execute

concepts.name: executable_is_not_admissible
concepts.canonical_statement: Technical executability is not admissibility; commit-time standing must remain valid and reconstructable before consequence may bind.
concepts.authority_boundary: Only a separately established authority path may authorize consequential execution.
non_claims: sandbox success is not execution authority
repair does not bypass standing
DENY cannot commit
common_misinterpretations: equating code completion with activation
equating hosted test success with production authority

concepts.name: fail_closed_blocks_unjustified_commit
concepts.canonical_statement: Underdetermined standing must FAIL-CLOSED and remain uncommitted, sandboxed, quarantined or repaired until reevaluation.
concepts.authority_boundary: FAIL-CLOSED is a consequence boundary; it does not create authority and does not prove a candidate false.
non_claims: underdetermined does not equal denied as false
sandbox state alone cannot commit to reality
common_misinterpretations: treating fail-closed as permanent epistemic impossibility
allowing uncertainty to bind reality

concepts.name: gtg_reconstruction_has_distinct_causal_authority_and_reality_contact_layers
concepts.canonical_statement: GTG separately reconstructs causal structure, authority structure and reality contact; R5 fails closed or partial on stale, contradicted, detached, internal-only, request-only, custody-broken or authority-escalating evidence.
concepts.authority_boundary: Reconstruction results do not independently create execution, certification, empirical-validity, mathematical-closure, release or universal-admissibility authority.
non_claims: reconstruction is not execution
reality-contact reconstruction is not universal truth
common_misinterpretations: collapsing causal reconstruction and authority reconstruction
treating reconstructed evidence as self-authorizing

concepts.name: independent_validation_is_non_authorizing
concepts.canonical_statement: Independent validation may recompute and test target claims while remaining separate from target doctrine and authority.
concepts.authority_boundary: Validation Factory does not own AE commit-time resolution, canonical evaluator semantics, execution authority, certification, publication, mathematical closure, empirical validity, universal admissibility or Master Records custody.
non_claims: approval is not continuity
execution is not admissibility
common_misinterpretations: allowing a validator to become the source of the validated doctrine
treating validation completion as release authority

concepts.name: stegcore_admissible_existence_is_an_operational_projection
concepts.canonical_statement: StegCore structurally adopts the upstream Admissible-Existence formalism through a bounded capability lifecycle and evidence registry; it supplements and does not replace AE/RTG/GTG/TT/STCM formalism authority.
concepts.authority_boundary: Core structural checks may block but may not widen canonical StegGate or component-owner authority; the primitive performs no external execution and mints no continuity receipt.
non_claims: DECLARED/STANDING/ADMISSIBLE/ACTIVATED is not the complete upstream theory of Admissible Existence
capability registry is not TT
file presence does not infer activation
common_misinterpretations: entering through StegCore and treating the Core projection as the source formalism
treating ACTIVATED as authority beyond the evidence and component boundary it records

concepts.name: continuity_recoverability_preserves_reconstructable_transition_history
concepts.canonical_statement: Continuity-intact standing requires retained history sufficient to reconstruct prior state, policy, authority, delegation, evidence, decision and transition history, together with a basin for preserving or restoring that condition.
concepts.authority_boundary: Continuity evidence does not independently authorize a new transition.
non_claims: continuity is not mere file persistence
continuity evidence does not erase authority requirements
common_misinterpretations: reducing continuity to endpoint co-presence
treating continuity receipts as permission for successor execution

known_orientation_hazards.description: TT FORMAL_STANDING_SPEC describes exactly 13 target transition elements while current TT operational handoff reports 76 unique transition elements across 11 registries.
known_orientation_hazards.required_handling: Do not infer contradiction or equivalence without reading the current TT registry hierarchy; treat the relationship between foundational target elements and expanded operational registries as a version/structure clarification task owned by TT if not already explicit.

known_orientation_hazards.description: AE may own normative protocol documentation while originating research doctrine or completed source reconstruction implementation remains in another repository.
known_orientation_hazards.required_handling: Distinguish source doctrine, normative protocol publication, independent validation and operational consumption before declaring a missing implementation.

known_orientation_hazards.description: Recent StegCore Admissible-Existence implementation is internal development infrastructure, not a public/user entry point.
known_orientation_hazards.required_handling: Do not create public-facing consumer-map requirements merely because internal formalism is distributed across repositories.
